subject: Temporary billing delegate + who generates invoice (portal vs. email)
body:
From: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@alpenhealth.de>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Giordano <marco.giordano@alpenhealth.de>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Billing: who actually issues the invoice during portal onboarding?

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one as we start the onboarding: our AP team needs to know whether Redwood will be creating the invoice PDF (and sending to our AP inbox) or if we should expect invoices to appear only in your portal. Some of our subsidiaries require a paper/pdf copy by email for PO reconciliation.

Two quick clarifications would help:
- Who is listed as the invoice originator? (Redwood Inc. or AlpenHealth local entity)
- If we opt into the portal, do you still provide an email copy for our archive? If not, we need a temporary manual push while our portal account is provisioned.

Also attaching our VAT cert — and we can provide a signed delegate letter if you need someone else to request invoices on our behalf while onboarding.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Müller
Head of AP, AlpenHealth GmbH
attachments: alpenhealth-vat-cert.pdf

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@alpenhealth.de>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Billing: who actually issues the invoice during portal onboarding?

Thanks Anna — short answers and an operational runbook below.

1) Invoice originator: Redwood Inc. (we can add your local billing reference on the stub).
2) Delivery options: two modes
   - Portal primary (recommended): invoices posted to the portal; we can enable an automated email fanout to a single AP inbox for 90 days while your portal admin completes provisioning.
   - Email primary: we generate and email PDF invoices to the AP inbox every month; we keep invoice metadata in the portal for searches.

For your immediate need, we can:
- Accept a signed delegate letter (PDF) authorizing Marco (copied) as your temporary billing agent; once we receive that, we will enable manual invoice push to marco@alpenhealth.de for two billing cycles.

Operational checklist (what we need from AlpenHealth to proceed):
- Signed delegation (PDF) authorizing temporary push recipient and duration
- Confirm preferred AP email for copies (cc any PO exceptions)
- VAT certificate (received)

Connor — can you prepare the manual push playbook and flag any limits on file size/format? Ben, FYI in case we surface the request to the account manager for SLAs.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Anna Müller <anna.mueller@alpenhealth.de>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Billing: who actually issues the invoice during portal onboarding?

Hi all,

We can do the manual push as a one-off while the portal account is created. Notes:
- Format we send: PDF (A4), filename pattern: Redwood_Invoice_YYYYMMDD_InvoiceNumber.pdf
- Max attachment per email: 10MB (we can split if needed)
- We will include the invoice metadata (invoice number, PO, VAT breakdown) in the email body for easier AP ingestion
- We need the signed delegation to be on company letterhead with the following fields filled: delegate name, email, effective dates, and authorized signature

I'll draft a short template for the signed-authority-letter and attach it below. If AlpenHealth prefers, we can also do a DocuSign route (faster).

Connor O'Brien
Billing Ops Specialist | Redwood Inference
attachments: signed-authority-template.docx

---
From: Marco Giordano <marco.giordano@alpenhealth.de>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@alpenhealth.de>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 16:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Billing: who actually issues the invoice during portal onboarding?

Hi Kimberly / Connor,

Thanks — we've signed the delegation and attached it here along with our local VAT. We'd like the manual email push for Oct and Nov invoices while we finish portal provisioning. A couple of asks:
- Can you include PO-17822 on the invoice metadata (we'll reference it when posting to our AP system)
- If any amounts are subject to reverse charge, flag clearly in the email body so our tax team can pick it up

Attached: signed-authority-letter.pdf, alpenhealth-vat-cert.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marco
Marco Giordano
AP Operations, AlpenHealth GmbH
attachments: signed-authority-letter.pdf, alpenhealth-vat-cert.pdf
